5311.title: Explicit ACP catalog failures become successful default-only results
5311.rootCauseOneLine: An explicit CLI listing with no usable process-local catalog falls through to a successful acp-default-only result, which the server persists.
5311.proposedFix: Reject explicit CLI model listing when neither fresh nor cached catalog is available; retain existing default and cache paths.
5311.caveats: Repeated by the same agent on Linux; the private macOS incident and scheduler retry volume were not recreated.
